title: Overbooking Relocation Allowance Rates, Hotel Rate Plans
content:
Where a property cannot honour a reservation as booked, the allowance reimbursed is the figure the Hotel Rate Plans schedule records against the plan booked. It is an amount per room per night.

| Rate plan | Relocation allowance, per room per night, USD |
| --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 125.0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 125.0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 150.0 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 175.0 |
| Member Flex Rate | 200.0 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 250.0 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 300.0 |

The figure rises with the plan, from the 125.0 USD the two cheapest plans share to the 300.0 USD the All-Inclusive Flex Rate records. No plan records an allowance of nothing.

*A worked reading.* Two rooms over 3 nights on the Standard Flexible Rate, at the 175.0 USD per room per night this schedule records, come to 1,050.00 USD.
